subtitle: Talent Forge Finale — Rich Tree, Private Backgrounds & Music Studio
changes: Refined Talent Forge with a reversible focused tree view, richer native skill cards, visible node/point controls and official spell-media thumbnails in talent search and comparison panels.
Added a private locally stored GIF/MP4/WebM companion background with visibility, readability shade, blur, fill/contain, show/hide and remove controls.
Added an optional private local music library and compact Alchemist-style player with Play/Pause, skip, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat and playlist controls; no visualizer or external music services.
Persists user-selected backgrounds and audio in this browser using IndexedDB where supported; files are never uploaded to the GitHub site, Blizzard or Cloudflare.
Preserved official gear imagery, Talent Command, Visual Build Architect, source data, current local save formats, Battle.net integration, four-bundle deployment, and PC/iPhone layout.
